pass_gates.rule: Canonical revision-5 real seed identity is reused without fabrication.
Candidate easting/northing remains finite British National Grid input.
Current HMLR Index Polygons download is published 2026-07-05.
Index Polygon files are replaced on the first Sunday of each month.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are a subset of registered freehold property.
Current dataset covers England and Wales.
Files are separated by local authority.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary can appear in both authority files.
Each INSPIRE Index Polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID.
Land Registry-INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title.
One registered title may contain several separate polygons.
Each separate polygon has its own INSPIRE ID.
INSPIRE polygon shows indicative position and extent only.
Registered-title extent cannot be established from INSPIRE polygon and requires the individual title plan.
Missing INSPIRE ID is not proof of unregistered land because leasehold/other tenure may be outside the freehold subset.
INSPIRE Index Polygons are reusable under the Open Government Licence.
Current files are published as GML.
HMLR polygon coordinates are captured against British National Grid.
Native candidate/polygon matching remains EPSG:27700.
BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection can shift features by up to 15 metres, so WGS84 proximity is nonterminal.

EA LIDAR vertical accuracy is plus/minus 15 cm RMSE.
EA publishes a 1m DTM WCS data service for raw coverage access.

Revision-14 requires at least three valid EA pixels inside verified fresh polygon geometry.
Revision-14 requires ODN vertical provenance and no inferred datum.
OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution DTM used only as an independent broad-scale crosscheck.
OS Terrain 50 grid has regular 50m spacing.
OS Terrain 50 grid supply uses 10km by 10km tiles.
Each Terrain 50 ASCII grid tile contains 200 pixels per row at 50m spacing.
Terrain 50 grid height values are calculated at pixel centres.
Terrain 50 grid height values are supplied to nearest 0.1m.
OS Terrain 50 is updated annually in July.
